aboutHistoryText1: KSC Wiedikon was founded in 1982 by three physical education teachers — Václav Arazim, René Zeender and Sylvia Schaerer. From the very first season, both basketball and volleyball players took to the court as KSCW members. What began as a neighbourhood initiative of enthusiastic athletes quickly grew into a staple of Zurich's recreational sports scene. Thanks to committed members and strong youth development, the club was able to steadily build new teams from its earliest years.
aboutHistoryText2: In the years that followed, KSC Wiedikon broadened its offering: badminton was played for several seasons from 1985, and floorball (Unihockey) for a time from 1989. On the competitive side, the women's basketball team was one of the club's flagships, battling for points in National League B for several years. Today, KSC Wiedikon counts over 300 active members in more than 20 teams, from regional leagues to recreational sport, making it one of the largest multi-sport clubs in Zurich's District 3. The close ties to the Wiedikon neighbourhood, the family-like atmosphere, and the passion for sport remain the foundation of the club.
aboutCommunityText: At KSC Wiedikon, togetherness is at the heart of everything we do. Whether on or off the court — we are one team. New members are warmly welcomed and quickly find their place in our diverse club family.
aboutFairplayText: Respect towards opponents, referees, and teammates is a given for us. We always compete fairly — in training, in matches, and in club life.
aboutDevelopmentText: From the first trial training to the regional league, we foster the athletic and personal development of our members. Our coaches rely on modern methods and individual support.

membershipTrainingText: Our experienced coaches offer structured training sessions for all skill levels. Multiple times per week in well-equipped halls in Zurich-Wiedikon.
membershipCommunityText: KSCW is more than a sports club. Club events, group outings, and an active community make us a family — on and off the court.

membershipRegistrationText: Becoming a KSCW member is simple. Just three easy steps:
membershipStep1Text: Come to a training session with no obligation and get to know the team. You can attend up to three trial sessions before deciding. Simply sign up via the contact form or email.
membershipStep2Text: After the trial training, you'll receive the registration form from the coach. Fill it in and hand it in directly or send it by email to the board.
membershipStep3Text: You'll receive a confirmation email with all further information — access to the members' platform, training times, and contact persons for your team.
schedulingIntroText1: KSC Wiedikon's game scheduling enables efficient coordination of home games. Our teams play their home games on designated game Saturdays, where multiple teams can play on the same day in different time slots. The scheduling automatically considers hall availability, referee assignments, and conflicts.
schedulingIntroText2: Opposing teams can book their preferred game dates directly through our online tool. Confirmation is sent automatically via email.
schedulingSaturdaysText: Most home games take place on game Saturdays. Three time slots are available per Saturday, spread across our halls. This allows multiple teams to play simultaneously or consecutively.
schedulingOpponentsText: As an opposing team, you can book your home game dates with us directly online. You'll receive a personalised link to the scheduling tool from your KSCW contact. There you can see all available dates and time slots and select your preferred date.

privacySubtitle: Information about how we handle your data
privacyIntro: KSC Wiedikon takes the protection of your personal data seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with Swiss data protection legislation (DSG) and this privacy policy.
privacyResponsibleText: Responsible for data processing on this website is:
privacyCollection: Collection and Storage of Personal Data
privacyHostingText: Our website is hosted by Hetzner Online GmbH, Industriestr. 25, 91710 Gunzenhausen, Germany. The server is located in the Nuremberg datacenter, Germany. When you visit our website, Hetzner automatically collects information in server log files that your browser transmits. Processing is based on our legitimate interest in providing a secure and efficient website. We have concluded a data processing agreement (DPA) with Hetzner.
privacyCollectionText: When you visit our website, general information is automatically collected (server log files). This includes browser type, operating system, referrer URL, IP address, and the time of the server request. This data cannot be assigned to a specific person and is used for statistical evaluation.
privacyContactText: When you send us enquiries via the contact form or feedback form, your details (name, email address, message) are stored for processing the enquiry. Contact form data is deleted after the enquiry is resolved, at the latest after 90 days. Feedback data is retained until the suggestion is implemented or declined. We will not share this data without your consent.
privacyCookiesText: Our website uses cookies for the theme setting (Light/Dark Mode). No tracking cookies or third-party cookies are used.
privacyErrorTrackingText: We use Sentry to detect and resolve technical errors on our website. When an error occurs, technical information such as browser type, operating system, error details, and the visited page are transmitted to Sentry (Functional Software, Inc., servers in Germany). No personal data such as names or email addresses is collected. Processing is based on our legitimate interest in the stability and security of the website.
privacyThirdPartyText: Our website uses OpenStreetMap for map views. When loading the map, data is transmitted to the OpenStreetMap Foundation. For more information, please refer to OpenStreetMap's privacy policy. On team pages, Instagram content may be embedded. This content is only loaded after your explicit consent. When loaded, data is transmitted to Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd.
privacyRightsText: You have the right to information, correction, and deletion of your personal data stored by us. For corresponding enquiries, please contact:
privacyChangesText: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy from time to time to ensure it always complies with current legal requirements. The current privacy policy applies to each subsequent visit.

basketballSpielplanungHall1Desc: Our main venue at Kantonsschule Wiedikon. All basketball home games take place here.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU18BoysDesc: Our U18 boys team plays in the regional youth league and prepares for the transition to senior teams. Technique, tactics, and team spirit are the focus.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU18GirlsDesc: The U18 girls are an ambitious team with strong cohesion. They participate in regional tournaments and continuously develop their playing skills.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU16BoysDesc: In the U16 category, basketball fundamentals are deepened. Positional play and game understanding are specifically promoted.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU16GirlsDesc: The U16 girls train with enthusiasm and regularly participate in league games. Fun in basketball comes first.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU14BoysDesc: Our U14 boys learn the basics of basketball: dribbling, passing, shooting, and first tactical concepts in a playful manner.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU14GirlsDesc: The U14 girls develop their basketball skills in a motivating environment. Teamwork and joy of movement are central.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU12BoysDesc: In the U12 category, the playful introduction to basketball is the focus. Coordination, ball handling, and fun shape the training sessions.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU12GirlsDesc: The U12 girls discover basketball with lots of energy and joy. Age-appropriate training sessions teach basic techniques and love of the game.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU10MixedDesc: Our U10 team is mixed and offers children the ideal introduction to basketball. Playful exercises, mini tournaments, and lots of fun await the young athletes.
basketballTeamsNachwuchsU8MixedDesc: The youngest team in the club! Here, children from age 5 learn their first steps with the basketball. Movement, coordination, and fun are at the centre - completely without performance pressure.
